findings.title: Private user_said special handlers persist stripped intent instead of raw ASR
findings.trigger: An ordinary non-wake captured utterance such as 雪妃，登记声纹 routes to identity/speaker special handler. The UI transcript is emitted before routing and remains full ASR text.
source_trace: BoardDialogueJobs._execute emits transcript(text) with original _admit_text result.
Candidate _route overwrites text with strip_address(text) before special handler dispatch.
LocalIdentityReplies.__call__ receives stripped text and ends with controller.prepare_local_sequence(text,...).

BoardDialogueController._prepare/store.begin_turn consequently records the stripped text as the user event, while UI reports the raw transcript. Ordinary prepare_text and PairedMemoryCommands paths retain raw input.
findings.impact: Private five-minute user_said timeline loses the original character-address prefix on identity/speaker local replies. UI transcript and persisted source differ. This finding excludes visual device_event canonical records, which intentionally must not contain the raw private ASR.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep immutable raw record_text separate from intent_text. For private user_said prepare_local_reply/prepare_local_sequence only, verify original scope exactly matches job.scope then pass original record_text to the record entrance. Preserve producer intent text. Explicit device_event or device-scope calls stay normalized; do not apply a blanket raw proxy across scopes.
findings.existing_test_gap: test_stream_packets_raw_asr_and_full_pcm_ack_are_original checks only ordinary controller.prepare_text. Current special fake store checks explicit memory source IDs, not actual raw special user_event text.

additional_semantics_to_decide.trace: GTK show_page(vision) calls portrait.set_visible(False), emitting unmap. on_unmapped stops the GL frame timer but does not clear mailbox.ready/pair READY. Returning to a visible page restarts rendering; actual paint_at age is exposed.
additional_semantics_to_decide.consequence: If ready means allocated renderer after first successful swap, this can be intentional hidden-page behavior. If ready must mean currently presenting, business can continue while avatar is hidden/stale. Specify hidden vs lost readiness rather than treating normal page switching as permanent GL failure.
additional_semantics_to_decide.root_decision: Normal camera/settings-page hiding is allowed to continue audio. READY means the context is still usable after first successful swap. Context loss/unrealize must fail closed; hidden/visible metrics may clarify stale FPS without cancelling normal paging.

traced_paths_without_found_source_defect: NativeLogicCore inherits AvatarPlayer.__init__/send/apply_response/new_turn/cancel/reset_playback/burst_completion; constructor sets idle_gain/generation/cache/state fields. Its pool returns empty, so inherited seed_speaking_materials does not load old PNGs.

NativeStreamingController manually restores exactly stream=None/completed_streams=[] from original StreamingController.__init__, then clones RealtimeController.__init__ with only RealtimeFacials replaced by NumericFacials. All attributes read by source start/text/control/audio/end/pause/cancel/completion methods are initialized.
NumericFacials retains begin/stop/values and existing sample-clock interpolate; inherited streaming and realtime paths invoke apply only on nonremote images, which StrictLocalPortrait never returns.

StrictLocalPortrait returns _portrait_wait before first draw, preventing old display_frame fallback. GL create marks only prepared; observer after egl.swap sets drawn/READY and triggers one-shot board_business.activate.

Renderer failed()/unrealize clears readiness and pair.fail invalidates jobs immediately, revokes candidate RAM microphone choice, and queues the existing RecordingController/stream cancellation. Board job generation invalidation clears waiting/playback/progress before a queued late ACK can pass its current check; player completion remains original full PCM receipt path.

Pair identity metadata remains separate from user profile catalogue/profile_selection/ProfileAccess grants. bind_runtime_pair changes only named per-instance methods/guards/context wrappers before workers start.
Private context/memory function namespaces copy globals before replacing speech preparation and CHARACTER_NAME; shared default modules and raw literal names/numbers/negations are not rewritten.

Handsfree constructor reads CandidateMonitorChoice false; its later GL-ready transition does not turn the choice on. Capture factories are created lazily; microphone startup is not armed by the pair-ready callback. Manual future record commands still require an explicit operator action.

GUI candidate owns one EGL widget; native_pixels/native_video stay None on this branch, worker does not allocate a second pixel sink or compose old PNGs, and fixed_native path requests16 rather than fallback8.
live_still_required: Actual GTK/PyGObject/EGL/Mali creation, first mapped swap, source hashes and full nonPython resource binding.
Real sink/PCM pause-resume/cancel and renderer error/unrealize timing versus ACK; source trace and existing fakes are not hardware acceptance.
Whole-board person-present/absent ASR/camera/identity/memory workload at actual16fps and full original queue capacities.
Explicitly chosen microphone activation and new display-name pronunciation/wake behavior, only after the source provenance fix.

visual_device_event_guard.behavior: prepare_local_reply(normalized, scope=configured device scope, input_source=device_event, topic=ANSWER_TOPIC, metadata=device_confirmed+normalized_visual_query claims). The raw question belongs only to private RAM channel transcript. v2 source fix must not replace this normalized text or copy personal scope.

followup.status: Root assigned narrow source-provenance fix; v1 frozen retained
suggested_regressions: Real LocalIdentityReplies with non-wake addressed speaker/face request; actual Store.begin_turn receives raw sentence while business/flow intent receives stripped text.
Visual device_event call retains exact normalized text, device scope/topic/source/claims and no raw private question.
Bare self-name path returning DIALOGUE_ROUTE records the original raw input once, without a second begin_turn.
